artifacts.summary: Confirms the 0.66 tok/s event live in journalctl but shows it is an outlier on top of an already-depressed baseline (~9-13 tok/s prompt-eval, ~5.5-7.7 tok/s decode) that itself runs several-fold below the HX 370's published CPU reference; rules out generic-build and oversized-context causes, leaves memory-contention and thermal/power-limiting as unresolved candidates, and flags an unrelated Sapience-client thread-throttle quirk.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 140 to create an implementation plan for the controlled idle re-benchmark and sensor instrumentation named in the report's Recommendations, then decide local-vs-anthropic viability once that number is in hand.
